I rarely leave reviews on Google Maps, but this physiotherapy clinic truly made a big difference for me. A few days ago, I suffered a lumbar ligament strain, and thanks to the therapist’s professional treatment, my recovery was much faster than expected.

If you are in Chiang Mai—whether traveling or living here—and need physical therapy or body recovery, this is definitely a place you can trust.

I went in with pain in my elbows and wrist after over a month of pain, waking up to numbness and restricted movements. I was told it’s likely to be tennis elbow. My first session was with the man who runs the clinic and another therapist. I didn’t have to explain much and they knew exactly where I needed to be worked on. My conditions improved drastically after 2 painful 90 minutes sessions of combined Thai massages, an acupuncture, nerve picking, and tok sen. Keep in mind their English is not the best, but the service is professional and friendly.

We are foreigners. Our calves were so tight and uncomfortable that we went to many massage parlors but to no avail. The special techniques used here relieved me a lot. It's the best massage I've ever had!

I first walked in with lower back, shoulder and hip pain in the base of over use from being on the computer/sewing machine. They worked on my hip and lower back with massage and with the use of technique. I was completely 80% pain free once they were done. Just happy I got rid of quite a bit of pain just from 1 session and I’ll continue my 2nd-3rd. All the staff were nice. Recommend this place.

text: I give it 5 stars! The massage here is unlike any I've ever had. It starts with getting a membership card, filling out information, checking blood pressure and body temperature, and asking about my symptoms. I came for stiffness in my legs, hamstrings, and the sides of my calves. Usually, with Thai massages, they only touch those areas lightly. But here, I can only say one thing: it was intense! You have to endure the pressure and manipulation to release the stiffness and knots. Two therapists helped with the pressure and body movements – it was amazing! I highly recommend it. The price is reasonable considering the results. Parking is available next to the shop, which is convenient. You have to try it! It'll solve your problem!
